initial_optimizer: Parent saved HF weights and ValueNorm but no Adam. One disclosed fresh-Adam boundary at total round48, no new critic warmup.
later_optimizer: Native DCP saves and reloads both learners' Adam steps/moments and parameters; per-rank fingerprints checked. Critic ValueNorm preserved; original H0/W1 fixed references retained.

plateau: At least192 additional rounds. Last4 consecutive48-round observations have range<=2pp, and no new all-time accuracy record of at least0.5pp in3 intervals. Label operational development plateau, not mathematical convergence.
budget_stop: If maximum768 additional rounds or24h expires without the plateau rule, report budget exhausted and convergence unestablished, not converged. Numerical/resource failures stop explicitly.

scope: No new SAO training, no independent training seeds, no component ablations; long-run absolute-performance study, not equal-rollout evidence.
